description: This file implements a FastAPI web application with WebSocket support, including an HTML frontend for a chat interface. It defines endpoints for serving the chat page and handling WebSocket connections with token/cookie authentication.

methods.name: get()
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET request for the root URL, serving the chat HTML page

methods.name: get_cookie_or_token( websocket: WebSocket, session: str | None = Cookie(default=None), token: str | None = Query(default=None), )
methods.description: Retrieves session cookie or token query parameter for WebSocket authentication

methods.name: websocket_endpoint( websocket: WebSocket, item_id: str, q: int | None = None, cookie_or_token: str = Depends(get_cookie_or_token), )
methods.description: Handles WebSocket connections for a specific item ID, echoing message with token/session info
